description: Direction de l'Urbanisme, Ville de Paris publishes a detailed vector layer of the buildings of Paris that separates each building into volumes by height and by projecting or set-back parts, with attributes such as building nature, source, plan height, footprint area, number of floors and creation and update dates; an attached note describes the attributes and the geometric modelling. Coverage: the city of Paris, France; about 362,000 records, with annual updates and the record last modified on 2026-09-24. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the Paris open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Database License (ODbL); cost: free. Caveats: the modelling rules are in an attached PDF note that was not read, so attribute meanings follow the field names only; the layer holds volumes, so several records can belong to one building. Simulation uses: building-level exposure, roof and façade areas for solar and heat models, and 2.5D geometry for wind, flood and noise simulations in a city digital twin. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap); Project PLATEAU: 3D city models of Japan (data-plateau-japan-3d-city-models).
